issue.title: Measure the Mermaid handoff in a 20-swarm post-release pilot
issue.description: Proposed by sase-1ml.2 note #2 and explicitly deferred by plan:202610/research_swarm_mermaid_diagrams.md. After a plugin release containing c56e3f7 and da1c380 and a human-authorized reinstall, observe about 20 real research swarms. Do not perform a global installation implicitly. First confirm the loaded plugin contains research/diagrams and the nullable diagrams swarm input. Collect each swarm ID, diagrams ready/none/failed/missing, accepted and omitted IDs/reasons, hook rendered N of M lines and warnings, image-agent added runtime, and available Bryan Highlights annotations on diagram pages. Cover no proposals/missing variable, duplicate anchors/source mismatch, reordering/renamed headings/table-to-list/merged passages, existing lead diagrams/two proposals on one block, image plus audio, and actual PDF rendering. Preserve reports as evidence and publish a measured recommendation. Apply the accepted design reopen criteria: image segment is the critical path or produces weak diagrams => consider a dedicated strong text model; >~10% omitted for placement => stable lead anchors; most proposals rejected or duplicate the infographic => narrower scope or a light linker pass. Reference file:explicit:cae0244aee50638db5d56447 (Rollout and reopen conditions). Size medium: bounded observation and analysis with named measures and explicit acceptance scenarios. This is post-release behavioral acceptance, not missing implementation; all task statuses, the past-week sweep, and active-epic scopes were checked without finding a duplicate or a causally responsible epic.

task_type_fields.proposal: Run the agreed approximately 20-swarm post-release diagram pilot and report usefulness, omissions, PDF rendering, added runtime, and whether the explicit reopen thresholds were crossed.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The epic explicitly excludes end-to-end live-swarm acceptance until plugin release and reinstall. This bounded rollout assessment is proposed by sase-1ml.2 note #2 and does not block completion of the implemented v1 contract.

issue.creation_reason: Preserve the explicit rollout follow-up from sase-1ml.2 note #2 so diagram quality, omission rates, PDF behavior, and latency are assessed after release and reinstall.

payload.entry:
The research/diagrams selection criteria changed in this sase-research-artifacts commit, from restraint-first (zero as the usual outcome; overlap with the infographic counted as a repeat) to panel drill-downs: the infographic is the overview, and each proposed diagram opens one panel with report detail the panel had no room for.

Pilot swarms must record which plugin version they ran (installed sase-research-artifacts version / git SHA), so pre-change and post-change runs are not mixed when measuring the share of runs with at least one diagram.

A diagram that expands an infographic panel with report detail is the intended outcome, not a duplicate. Treat "duplicates the infographic" as a failure signal only when the diagram redraws a panel at the same level of detail.
